help.title: Aequitas کا استعمال کیسے کریں
help.subtitle: Aequitas پلیٹ فارم پر ماڈلز کا آڈٹ، تدارک اور تصدیق کرنے کے لیے مرحلہ وار گائیڈ۔

help.step5_desc: ڈیٹا پاس ہونے پر، اپنے ریگولیٹری ریکارڈ کے لیے آفیشل آڈٹ سرٹیفکیٹ ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں۔

landing.deep_arch_subtitle: Click any card above or switch below to inspect statutory adherence, algorithms, and real-time mitigation telemetry.
landing.f1_overview: Continuously monitors model inference streams and dynamically applies Kamiran-Calders reweighting and adversarial debiasing. Unprivileged demographic groups are equalized in real time without sacrificing predictive ROC-AUC accuracy or operational throughput.
landing.f1_regulation: NYC Local Law 144 • EEOC 29 C.F.R. § 1607 (Four-Fifths Rule) • EU AI Act Art. 10
landing.f1_bullet1: Automated reweighting of biased training records before production deployment
landing.f1_bullet2: Preserves model utility and downstream predictive power with zero label drift
landing.f1_bullet3: Instant rollback checkpoints for total regulatory transparency and safety
landing.f2_subtitle: Deep dataset inspection & proxy feature discovery
landing.f2_overview: Dissects high-dimensional feature spaces, NLP token embeddings, and tabular distributions to detect indirect proxy bias (such as postal codes, educational markers, or colloquial phrasing) that secretly correlate with protected categories.
landing.f2_regulation: EU AI Act Art. 10 (Data Governance) • NIST AI RMF 1.0 (MAP 2.3)
landing.f2_bullet1: Identifies covert proxy features masking protected demographic categories
landing.f2_bullet2: Evaluates statistical parity difference and equalized opportunity metrics
landing.f2_bullet3: Automated distribution shift detection between training and live inference
landing.f3_subtitle: Automated 4/5ths Rule adherence & legal audit readiness
landing.f3_overview: Executes continuous compliance checks against the EEOC Four-Fifths Rule and municipal algorithmic accountability statutes. Instantly flags adverse impact violations and generates tamper-evident audit filings formatted for enterprise legal counsel.
landing.f3_regulation: EEOC Uniform Guidelines § 1607.4D • Title VII Civil Rights Act
landing.f3_bullet1: Continuous benchmark evaluation against Title VII and EEOC standards
landing.f3_bullet2: Pre-configured legal export ready for compliance and board submission
landing.f3_bullet3: Automatic disparate impact threshold alerts with configurable sensitivities
landing.f4_subtitle: Transparent AI decision matrices & agent telemetry
landing.f4_overview: Provides real-time visibility into autonomous audit agent decision-making. Every metric evaluation, statistical hypothesis test, and proposed mitigation step is captured in high-frequency event streams with cryptographic verification.
landing.f4_regulation: EU AI Act Art. 12 (Record-Keeping) • ISO/IEC 42001 Standard
landing.f4_bullet1: Real-time terminal telemetry stream with step-by-step agent reasoning
landing.f4_bullet2: Traceable justification for every proposed fairness remediation
landing.f4_bullet3: Exportable audit logs compatible with Splunk, Datadog, and enterprise SIEMs
landing.f5_subtitle: Executive override controls & governance sign-off gates
landing.f5_overview: Guarantees that sensitive model remediations and threshold modifications are never committed without authorized human review. Empowers compliance officers and lead data scientists with dual-key approval gates and complete rollback capability.
landing.f5_regulation: EU AI Act Art. 14 (Human Oversight) • White House AI Bill of Rights
landing.f5_bullet1: Configurable approval thresholds for high-stakes decision models
landing.f5_bullet2: Interactive remediation diffs showing before/after disparate impact curves
landing.f5_bullet3: Auditor attribution tracking with timestamped executive validation
